source: discipline_rules (handbook rules only, no case data)

rules.description: SECOND CAUTION IN THE SAME MATCH
rules.handbook_text: Two cautions given to the same player in one game are an automatic 1 game suspension. A red card carries an automatic and minimum one game suspension.

rules.description: DENYING OPPONENT GOAL/GOAL-SCORING OPPORTUNITY BY HANDLING
rules.handbook_text: DOGSO is an automatic 1 game suspension. A red card carries an automatic and minimum one game suspension.

rules.description: DOGSO BY OFFENSE PUNISHABLE BY FK/PK
rules.handbook_text: DOGSO is an automatic 1 game suspension. A red card carries an automatic and minimum one game suspension.
Violent Conduct: Headbutt, Elbow, Stamping, Biting, Striking, Kicking Opponent: 2-4 games.
